title: Orange Posset
summary: A soft, creamy orange posset sharpened with a little lemon, topped with orange zest and served with fresh orange.

ingredients.note: needed for the set; orange alone is not sharp enough

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Mix the juices
steps.text: stir the orange and lemon juice together in the small bowl. Lemon juice gives the acid that orange juice lacks, so the posset sets.

steps.title: Reduce
steps.text: bring the cream, sugar, grated zest and salt to the boil and boil 6-8 min, stirring, until reduced to about 480 ml. Reduced cream gives a firmer set.

steps.title: Add juices
steps.text: off the heat, stir in the mixed juices.

steps.title: Strain and set
steps.text: rest 20 min, strain into the jug, pour into the bowls and chill at least 3 h.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: rest 10 min at room temperature, top with zest strips and serve with orange segments. Fresh segments add juicy contrast.

tips: A common mistake is leaving out the lemon juice; with orange alone the posset will not set.
Use a sweet, fragrant orange for the best flavour.
Remove all the white pith from the segments.
storage: Cover once set and keep in the fridge for up to 2 days. Cut the orange segments just before serving.
